values.note: River view $29.99 Monday-Thursday, $41.99 Friday-Sunday; riverfront $44.99 and $63.99. Premium weekends and events (Memorial Day, Regatta Week, Madison BBQ Party, Labor Day, Vintage Thunder, Chautauqua, Halloween): river view $65.99, riverfront $79.99. Rates exclude a 3.5% processing fee, 5% innkeepers tax and 7% sales tax.
2026 season: April 1 through the night of November 8.

summary: Fees added $29.99-$79.99; season Apr 1-Nov 8 2026; 50A; 45 ft; dump; count 33 confirmed. Note cleaned. Riverview vs operator's riverfront flagged.
flags: WATER (re-audit): stored riverview, but the city calls 18 sites 'bordering the beautiful Ohio River' and sells a Riverfront type. Imagery: the south row sits about 50 m from the bank across open grass, no levee visible; the north row is behind it. Looks like an earned riverfront for 18 of 33. Waterfront not changed.
WEBSITE: operator page now live, https://www.madison-in.gov/273/Riverview-Campground; stored website is only the Firefly booking link. Phone 812-292-2003 confirmed ('camp cell', Firefly).
BATHHOUSE: page says 'full bathhouse'; I did not write showers on that wording.

Base $29.99 passes the gate; premium-weekend rates top out at $79.99. No gateway within 40 km (Louisville 63). Public can book an ordinary night online; City of Madison runs it. PIN 38.732,-85.365 is within ~50 m of the rows, fine.
note: City of Madison campground on the Ohio River; 18 sites directly riverfront, the rest river-view; no tents. --Claude
